name: initscript-otel-agent
description: Install the OpenTelemetry Collector agent and start sending host metrics and logs (GPU metrics when a GPU is present) to the observability stack registered in CB-Tumblebug. A local vLLM server is found and scraped on its own. Env: OTEL_METRICS, OTEL_LOGS, OTEL_GPU (auto|on|off), OTEL_INTERVAL, OTEL_LOG_PATHS, OTEL_SCRAPE_TARGETS, OTEL_DISCOVER (auto|off)

scripts.name: otel-agent
scripts.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bootstraps the OTel agent from the observability stack registered in CB-Tumblebug (TB_OTEL_* exported by CB-Tumblebug).
set -e
: "${TB_OTEL_ENDPOINT:?no observability stack is registered in CB-Tumblebug (TB_OTEL_ENDPOINT is empty)}"
CA_OPT=""
if [ -n "${TB_OTEL_CA_B64:-}" ]; then
  echo "$TB_OTEL_CA_B64" | base64 -d > /var/lib/tb/otel-ca.pem
  CA_OPT="--cacert /var/lib/tb/otel-ca.pem"
fi
# the loop retries dropped connections, which curl --retry does not cover
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086
  curl -fsSL $CA_OPT --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 -o /var/lib/tb/install-otel-agent.sh "$TB_OTEL_ENDPOINT/dl/install-agent.sh" && break
  [ "$i" = 5 ] && { echo "cannot download the agent installer from $TB_OTEL_ENDPOINT"; exit 1; }
  sleep $((i * 5))
done
bash /var/lib/tb/install-otel-agent.sh
